# CG-RES-024: Response header added or optional header removed

A response header was added, or an optional one removed.

**Why it matters:** Optional headers were never guaranteed; added headers are ignored by existing consumers.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Responses](./#res) |
| Detects | `header.added`, `header.removed` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: low · undetermined: low |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> {what}: {where}.
>
> {explanation}
>
> **Fix:** {resolution}

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: ETag added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, headers: {ETag: {schema: {type: string}}}}}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. Header added: GET /x: header "etag" of response 200.

### Fires: optional Link removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, headers: {Link: {schema: {type: string}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, low. Optional header removed: GET /x: header "link" of response 200.

### Does not fire: required header removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, headers: {X-A: {required: true, schema: {type: string}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
